    • Isolation and sandboxing
    • Access control and permissioning
    • Auditability and traceability
    • Evaluation and quality measurement
    • Stability, reliability, and cost management
Cross-functional delivery

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and platform teams to standardise and productionise platform capabilities, improving delivery quality and engineering efficiency.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above (preferred majors: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related fields).

Experience

  • 8+ years in backend/platform engineering, architecture, or similar enterprise-scale delivery roles.
  • Recent 3 years, working in a commercial environment to deliver AI related production

System Thinking

  • Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.

Engineering Strength

  • Proficient in Java/Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems.

AI/Agent Architecture Skills (Must Have)

  • Deep understanding of LLMs and agent architectures, including:
    • Task decomposition & planning
    • Tool use / function calling patterns
    • Context and session management
    • Memory design
    • Execution loops and exception handling
  • Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).
  • Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equvlenece).

  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.

Platform & Cloud Engineering (Strong Plus)

  • Strong DevOps mindset; experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Ability to drive cross-team execution and deliver outcomes in production environments.

ln:4456874513.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Job Scope

  • SABRE (Standard Chartered Analytics Booking and Risk Engine) is the bank’s strategic platform for Financial Markets Risk and Valuations. It is entirely developed in house. SABRE is also the central data repository for all Financial Markets transactions providing information for regulatory and non-regulatory trade reporting purposes.
  • This role involves extending SABRE, which is a core component of the strategic architecture, to build a future-proof front to back strategic FM platform with an aim to migrate off legacy, obsolete and fragmented architecture to the new target platform to support the growing needs of FM business including regulatory reporting.

Job Purpose

  • Building strong, effective relationships with both the business and technology teams, across global offices.
  • Collaborating with trade platform teams, project teams and control functions to gather requirements, solve business problems by proposing relevant, innovative solutions.
  • Working as part of an agile team including Business Analysts, Developers and Testers and being able to identify business implications of technical design decisions and influence them accordingly.
  • Being a creative source of proposals and channelling user aspiration towards sustainable and future proof solutions.
  • Deliver functional consistency across the various projects by influencing architecture and design decisions.
  • Translating and documenting business requirements.
  • Working across asset classes of FX, ALM, Rates, Credits and Commodities.
  • Preferably strong expertise in confirmations / post trade space.

Diversity & Inclusion

  • Standard Chartered is committed to diversity and inclusion. We believe that a work environment which embraces diversity will enable us to get the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain strong business performance and competitive advantage. By building an inclusive culture, each employee can develop a sense of belonging, and have the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand user requirements and study the feasibility. Propose solutions that align to the strategic roadmap. Cleary document and agree on assumptions, shortfalls and timelines to resolve the known constraints and dependencies.
  • Pro-actively highlight risk and issues. Engage, manage and build strong relationships with both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Translate solutions into detailed, unambiguous, business and functional requirements.
  • Ensure the overall quality of business requirements, functional specifications and other supporting documents meet the bank’s standards.
  • Work proactively with fellow BAs and other team members, ensuring work is proportionally distributed and targets are met.
  • Ensure documents such as functional specs support the development of practical technology solutions and suitable test cases.
  • Work as part of a combined cross-functional agile team and support the on-going build as required e.g., drafting/reviewing of test cases, closing out developers open issues/questions, contributing to solution design etc.
  • Assist the business with UAT, including communication, planning, preparation and test case preparation.
  • Identify risks and issues early, plan mitigating steps and communicate these to PMs and business stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with project and programme managers to ensure stakeholders are fully engaged and expectations managed.
  • Delivery focused, committing to specific tasks and ensuring these and the overall projects deadlines are met.

Skills And Experience

  • Program Management, Project Management
  • Deep understanding in all aspects trade life cycle and Financial Markets
  • Strong knowledge of testing practices and test automation
  • Agile Project Management & Ways of Working

Technical Knowledge

  • Good understanding of the FO to BO trade flow of financial products, including Middle Office, Operations and Finance activities.
  • Experience working in big data solutions and data querying tools. Experience in (ES) elastic search is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of key technology concepts, basics in SQL, NoSQL, functional programming and architecture. Strong technical acumen is a big plus.
  • Experience implementing trade STP having multiple source platforms. FpML knowledge, ISDA CDM standards is a plus.

Preferred Domain Knowledge

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in full end to end financial markets project delivery life cycle.

Other Preferred Skills

  • Strong interpersonal, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Multicultural awareness
  • Displays personal authority, integrity, and ethics

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Full end to end FM projects delivery life cycle
  • Front to back knowledge
  • Technology concepts, basics in SQL, NoSQL, functional programming, and architecture
  • Financial Markets product knowledge across asset classes (FX, IRD, CRD etc) encompassing product & trade life cycle
  • Pricing & Risk
  • Regulatory reporting (MIFID II, EMIR, CFTC)

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in full end to end financial markets project delivery life cycle. End to end referring to front office to back-office implementation including project initiation, project planning, project execution, and project closure.
  • Strong understanding of key technology concepts, basics in SQL, NoSQL, functional programming and architecture.
  • Extensive Financial Markets product knowledge across asset classes encompassing product & trade life cycle (pricing and risk is good to have). (Regulatory like MIFID II, EMIR, CFTC exposure is a plus).
  • Experience implementing trade STP having multiple source platforms. FpML knowledge, ISDA CDM standards is a plus.
  • Experience working on vendor systems (eCommerce platforms, Murex, Bloomberg Trading System, Apex, Sophis, S2BX, Wealth Management systems).
  • Ability to work proactively, independently and displays strong initiative.
  • Pragmatic team player with an attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately translate and document business needs into functional requirements and produce quality documentation.
  • Ability to drive multiple agenda and effectively manage priorities.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with an excellent standard (written and spoken).

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

The Product Owner, Digital Wealth and Fund, is responsible for shaping and delivering client-centric digital wealth and fund journeys across mobile and web channels. The role owns the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital investment propositions, including fund discovery, transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, ensuring solutions are aligned to business priorities, client needs, regulatory expectations and technology strategy.

The role acts as the bridge between wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance and country teams. It translates business outcomes into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritises delivery based on client value and commercial impact, and drives execution through Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, release governance and post-implementation performance tracking.

The role requires strong digital wealth and fund domain knowledge, including understanding of investment products, client suitability, risk profiling, fund order flows, subscription and redemption processes, fees and charges, regulatory disclosures, cross-market operating requirements and servicing controls. The Product Owner is expected to simplify complex wealth journeys, improve client and frontline experience, and enable scalable platform capabilities across markets.

The candidate should also bring practical AI knowledge and the ability to identify responsible use cases for digital wealth, fund servicing and relationship manager enablement. This includes familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), predictive analytics and machine learning concepts, with sufficient understanding to work effectively with data science, engineering, architecture, model risk and governance teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Owns the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital investment propositions, including fund discovery, transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, ensuring solutions are aligned to business priorities, client needs, regulatory expectations and technology strategy
  • Maintains a commercial lens over the product, understand and communicate with relevant stakeholders on the commercial performance metrics and viability of products, and drive its adoption.
  • Acts as the bridge between wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance and country teams.
  • Owns the ‘WHY’ and ensure all members of the squad understand and embrace the vision & mission. The why should be closely aligned to the organization’s overall goals and ambitions.
  • Inspires the squad to continuously thrive in a growth mindset.
  • Sets goals and prioritise the backlog for the squad and create actions plans to target for timely delivery.
  • Bring practical AI knowledge and the ability to identify responsible use cases for digital wealth, fund servicing

Business

  • Act as an Agile Product Owner, owning the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital wealth and fund propositions, including fund discovery, investment transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, to support key wealth and retail banking strategic objectives.
  • Partner closely with wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance, operations and country teams to deliver client-centric, scalable and commercially viable digital investment solutions.
  • Use delivery and backlog management tools such as ADO to define, prioritise and manage epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria based on business value, client impact, regulatory needs, risk considerations and delivery dependencies.
  • Continuously gather feedback from clients, and country stakeholders to iterate platform capabilities, improve usability and drive adoption across digital wealth and fund journeys.
  • Define product requirements and development roadmaps based on digital wealth expertise, fund domain knowledge, market needs, client suitability, risk profiling, fund order flows, subscription and redemption processes, fees, disclosures and servicing controls.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and delivery teams to synchronise tasks, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, resolve trade-offs and align delivery expectations across business, technology and control functions.
  • Conduct pre-go-live demos, walkthroughs and readiness sessions with stakeholders, ensuring business, technology, operations, risk, compliance and support teams are aligned for smooth transition, launch and post-launch support.
  • Lead regular review and retrospective sessions to embed a growth mindset, identify delivery improvements, strengthen squad effectiveness and share learnings with the wider Product Owner community.

Processes

  • Clearly aligns squad OKRs & KPIs with stakeholders and senior management, ensure these objectives and targets are well understood and aligned to the nature of your product.
  • Communicates and embed the OKRs and KPIs into every aspect of the product life cycle.
  • Identifies and maps the data sources required to validate and measure the performance of the features.
  • Performs post implementation review with squad, define measurement windows and prepare necessary data & metrics.
  • Translate data insights into prioritized product improvements.

People & Talent

  • Coaches & mentor squad members to continuously uplift capability.
  • Fosters a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaboration.
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people.
  • Responsibility to review team capacity plans to ensure capabilities are released as per agreement with stakeholders.

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Is accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and services, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.
  • Identifies all risks and issues that may impact project viability. Track, manage and report them as per the Bank’s standards.

Governance

  • Adherence to policies and control standards, ensuring compliance and operation within risk tolerance and risk appetite
  • Maintain awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Bank operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’ within the deliverables and possessing the ability to constructively challenge relevant stakeholders and teams effectively.
  • Ability and willingness to work through details with relevant control functions in an open and collaborative manner to achieve the desired governance outcome within the bank’s risk appetite.
  • Work with global teams in Risk, Compliance and COO Office to ensure adherence to the Bank’s Risk framework, in the identification, assessment, mitigation, control and monitoring of risk.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Global WM Product Teams
  • Global and Country Technology teams
  • Product Owners across Digital Wealth Journey
  • Country WM Product Heads
  • Group, Regional and Country WM COO teams

Other Responsibilities

  • Do the right thing: Be brave, be the change; Think client; Live with integrity
  • Never Settle: Continuously improve and innovate; Simplify; Learn from your successes and failures
  • Better together: See more in others; How can I help? Build for the long term

  • Scrum or similar Agile development methodology

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in digital product delivery, technology implementation or platform transformation, preferably within wealth management, retail banking or financial services organisations.
  • 8 to 10 years of experience as an Agile Product Owner or similar product delivery role, with proven ability to own product vision, roadmap, backlog prioritisation, user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across multi-functional, multi-cultural and multi-market teams.
  • Strong communication skills, including oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex digital wealth, fund and technology topics to a broad audience.
  • Ability to translate client, business and regulatory requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
  • Experience designing and improving client journeys for digital wealth, fund investment and portfolio servicing across mobile and web channels.
  • Experience managing delivery with scrum masters, engineers, architects, designers, testers and control partners in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to plan, implement, evaluate and sustain product backlogs to achieve measurable client, business, adoption and risk outcomes.
  • Experience with analytics, AI, NLP or intelligent automation proofs of concept is an advantage, particularly for wealth insights, advisor assist, intelligent search, content summarisation or servicing use cases.
  • Experience in financial services applications, particularly digital wealth, fund platforms, wealth advisory, investment servicing, relationship manager enablement, KYC or client engagement solutions, would be an advantage.
  • Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required, with strong oral and written communication skills to engage stakeholders, document requirements and support delivery across regions.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Title Senior Analyst - Application Security

Department Global Cyber & Information Security (GCIS)

Location Dalian, China

Reports To Dalian Application Security Manager

Level Grade-3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

You will be joining a highly skilled Global Application Security team. Our primary mission is to protect the company is financial applications and data by finding security vulnerabilities before hackers do, and working closely with software developers to build secure applications from the ground up.

About Your Role

As an Application Security Specialist, you will act as a critical bridge between our Application Security team in Dalian and our software engineering teams based in Canada. Your main goal is to ensure that the applications built for our Canada business are secure by design.

You will spend your time actively “hacking” our own applications to find weaknesses, particularly in web applications and APIs. Equally important, you will help automate our security checks to configure DevSecOps tools that scan source code or runtime for vulnerabilities every time a developer updates an application (DevSecOps). You will work directly with the developers, advising them on how to fix the code effectively.

Because building relationships with the Canada technical teams is crucial for this role, you will be required to align part of your working hours with the North American time zone. This means you will work the local "Canada shift" (evening/night local Dalian time) approximately 2 days per week for critical meetings and real-time collaboration.

About You

  • Fluent English Communication: Exceptional spoken and written English skills are mandatory. You must be comfortable hosting video calls, presenting security findings, and offering technical advice to native English speaking teams in Canada and local Dalian teams.
  • Hands-on Penetration Testing Experience: Proven experience in ethical hacking, specifically targeting Web Applications and APIs. You should have a deep understanding of how to find and exploit common vulnerabilities (such as the OWASP Top 10).
  • DevSecOps & Automation Skills: Experience with integrating automated security scanning tools (SAST/SCA/DAST) into software development pipelines (CI/CD).
  • Developer-Friendly Mindset: A strong ability to understand software architecture and provide clear, practical remediation advice to developers. You enjoy solving problems collaboratively rather than just pointing out errors.

This position can be based in GBSKuala Lumpur or GBS Guangzhou. When prompted, please select your preferred location from the drop down. The recruitment team will contact you to confirm your preferred location if you are shortlisted.

Assurance is a Second line defence function established under a delegated Mandate from the Group Chief Risk Officer and the Group Head of Conduct, Financial Crime and Compliance (CFCR). The primary role of Assurance is to provide a risk-based independent view to Senior Management in the business/functions, Second Line and the Board as to the effectiveness of the bank’s policies, processes, systems and controls. It facilitates identification of any gaps & inefficiencies, enabling prompt corrective action to be taken, and is a key source of evidence for the Board & Regulators. Assurance is part of the reasonable steps taken in support of SMF 4, 16 & 17 responsibilities.

The Director, CFCR Assurance role operates within a globally integrated and fungible operating model, working closely with others in the CFCR Assurance team to focus on delivery of Assurance reviews within the CFCR Assurance remit.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support the Co-Lead, CFCR Assurance in delivering a strategy for risk-based and data-enabled assurance coverage across CFCR Assurance, aligned to the Bank’s risk profile, regulatory expectations and internal commitments.
  • Support the agenda to drive a collaborative risk and control ecosystem across the three Lines of Defence, including effective reliance and remediation tracking.
  • Support the agenda to drive a culture of continuous improvement in assurance delivery, including consistent methodology application, strong documentation and evidence standards, and timely reporting and escalation.

Business

  • Provide support on the delivery of the assurance plan and book of work to ensure alignment to CFCR Assurance priorities.
  • Maintain a strong quality culture across planning, fieldwork, reporting and issue validation.
  • Maintain strong awareness of CFCR Assurance regulatory expectations, internal policies/standards, and leading practices in risk management, control testing and assurance.

Processes

  • Work closely with teams across the three Lines of Defence, building good working relationships and engaging with 1LoD testing teams and Risk owners.
  • Follow the Group’s policies and standards, including how we carry out assurance work, track issues, and keep documentation clear and consistent.

People & Talent

  • Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness, where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy compliant conduct is the norm.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across the Group. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Risk Management

  • Retesting of controls to support the assessment on both design and operating effectiveness across key processes
  • Support the delivery of a dynamic plan that focuses assurance activity on areas of highest risk and greatest potential impact, including thematic work across geographies where appropriate.
  • Communicate issues and testing insights clearly to senior stakeholders as required, including through concise reporting, escalation and remediation validation

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

  • Globa Head of CFCRs Assurance Management Team
  • Global Head of Assurance’s Management Team
  • Risk Market CROs/CCO

  • COOs and Conduct and Control leads – business and functions
  • 1LOD testing teams
  • Key regulatory bodies (as required) e.g. Bank of England, HKMA, MAS etc.
  • Appointed Regulatory Monitors

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country/Market, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
  • Conduct internal investigation in rare circumstances where the both the Shared Investigative Services team and Compliance Speaking-up team are both implicated in an investigation.

  • Market Expertise
  • Independent Challenge
  • Commercial Mindset
  • Execution - Driven
  • Critical - Thinking
  • Solution Driven
  • Proficiency in Tech, AI/ Automation
  • Managing Change & Conflict
  • Integrity
  • People Leadership
  • Stakeholder management & Influence

  • Strong assurance, risk and control testing, regulatory inspection within a banking environment.
  • Substantial experience in the banking industry, including demonstrated success in a similar roles, including across a range of risk areas.
  • Experience in leading transformations in risk and control testing/audit/assurance.
  • Experience in optimising processes, including via the use of technology.
  • Strong leadership qualities, excellent interpersonal skills and personal authority based on trusted relationships.
  • Experienced in building leading and motivating teams.
  • Strategic vision for the function.
  • Excellent communicator, effective leader and manager of complex, highly matrixed organizations and the ability to explain complex risk terms in business language.
  • Ability to collaborate and work dynamically across country, region, business, and group stakeholders
  • Strong drive, high levels of integrity, independence, and enthusiasm.

  • Strong presentation skills and the overall knowledge, sound judgement and courage of conviction.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics.

  • Lead end-to-end technical delivery from discovery and design through build, testing, release, and production support.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to convert requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership across architecture decisions, solution design, implementation planning, and engineering standards.
  • Oversee the design and development of services and applications using Python and Java in enterprise environments.
  • Define and govern integration patterns, API strategy, security controls, observability, resilience, and performance requirements.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, risk controls, and software engineering best practices.
  • Drive delivery planning, dependency management, environment strategy, release readiness, and support models.
  • Review solution designs and code to ensure maintainability, extensibility, and operational stability.
  • Champion modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, code quality controls, and container/cloud deployment patterns where applicable.
  • Identify and manage technical risks, trade-offs, and issues with clear documentation and stakeholder communication. Mentor engineers and foster a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate across teams to align target architecture, delivery sequencing, and reuse of common capabilities.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in software engineering and technical delivery leadership in complex enterprise environments.
  • Solid development experience in Python and Java.
  • Proven track record in solution and application architecture, including distributed systems and service-oriented design.
  • Experience delivering scalable, resilient, and secure applications in production.
  • Strong background in API and microservice design, system integration, and event-driven or service-based architectures.
  • Good understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release management, and production support practices.
  • Practical experience with non-functional requirements including performance, reliability, recoverability, monitoring, and security.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across delivery execution, governance, and strategic change.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with pragmatic decision-making in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications：

  • Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architecture and container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with engineering metrics, delivery governance frameworks, and operational excellence practices.

Success Measures (First 12 Months)：

  • Delivery of priority initiatives on schedule with agreed quality outcomes.
  • Reduction in production incidents and improved service reliability metrics.
  • Improved release predictability, test automation coverage, and deployment efficiency.
  • Clear architecture decision records and stronger cross-team technical alignment

Job Summary

A highly skilled and experienced for Wealth Solutions Operations (i.e WSO). This role requires a responsible and detail-oriented professional with experience in operational project management, supporting business products/processes development and effectively managing operational risks and controls in WSO team. Support LM deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support LM to drive transformation of WS operation teams to align with WRB Client Journeys in the market. Oversee the innovation and continuous improvement projects relating to WS ops and be responsible for outcomes with related business stakeholders and 2nd lines.
  • Support LM to develop and sustain a compliance culture, ensure flawless execution and compliance to timely identify and address arising risks and control gaps if any.
  • Engage key stakeholders and within the broader business partners to ensure alignment across governance/control/conduct agendas.

Processes

  • Drive and deliver WSO process simplification and Project implementation by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Lead and oversee WS ops related platform to support WS digitization journey and initiatives delivery and ensuring the effectiveness of related project delivery in a coherent and seamless way and the consistency of functionality and control design across the platforms.
  • Lead and drive to identify and achieve WSO operations excellence and efficiency to be aligned with country, business, function strategy goals.

Risk Management

  • Reinforce the risk management, conduct and governance discipline, and driving alignment/streamlining of key operation processes by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Support the WS business to deliver the business priorities through continuously improving on process productivity and efficiency, meeting regulatory and internal policy requirements and driving a standardization agenda for the business as well as representation at the relevant risk/conduct/governance committees and forums by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Drive WSO data management framework implementation quality in function, manages data quality improvement project and new data elements collection from product/ other biz & regulatory requirements, and accountable for functional data leverage in business revenue driven/ risk monitoring/ processing automation. In addition, can provide support to LM to take the ownership and deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Governance

  • Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards as defined by internal and external requirements as well as ensure that identified risks are subject to appropriate remedial action.
  • Engage with key stakeholders to ensure alignment across governance / control / conduct agendas.
  • Ensure proper governance on data, systems, GBS and third parties as the business, operation and domain owner in accordance to regulations and bank policies.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Establish and implement a stable and reliable world class operating sales platform and control environment by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders.
  • Actively manage and remediate any breaches and deviations from global / local standards by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders

Accountable For Consumer Rights Protection Requirements (CN Required)

  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.

Accountability (CN Required)

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；

  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；

  • Country WRB Teams

  • Country Tech teams
  • Country 2nd line and 3rd line, e.g., CFCC, Legal, OR, Finance, and HR
  • Country External Regulators
  • Group Wealth COO teams including Group Product COO teams and Group WSO
  • Group CFCC, Legal and OR teams
  • Group Wealth Products teams
  • Group Wealth COO office

  • Product Governance
  • Project Management
  • Data Governance
  • PRT risk management
  • Conduct Management
  • Wealth Product Knowledge
  • Wealth Operations

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Above
  • Training: Data soft skills if any
  • Licenses: With CMF certification
  • Membership: No specific requirement
  • Certifications: With CMF certification
  • Languages: Affluent in writing and speaking

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

  • Ensures that AML/CDD/Sanctions (Individual Business) risks relating to the country are effectively managed end to end in accordance with Group and local regulatory requirements.
  • Assures AML/CDD/Sanctions (Individual Business) risk management through oversight and testing of the related CSTs and ensures material risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, monitored and reported / escalated in accordance with the bank’s Risk Management Framework.
  • Drives/coordinates/monitors initiatives, projects and actions to ensure the Bank operates in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations, Group/Country policies and standards, for the prevention of money laundering.

Key Responsibilities

  • China WRB Individual CDD team is a unit within the COO family for performing due diligence on Customer Due Diligence before approval.
  • Individuals CDD team CDD analyst is responsible for client contact for existing to bank clients for completion of CDD activities. However, the team can assign or take support from Relationship Managers (RMs) for completion of CDD activities / related requirements for priority clients.
  • Support China WRB individual business team, including Mass and Affluent Priority Banking, lending and Digital partnership. Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates.
  • Perform account Opening KYC/CDD for high risk rating clients and ETB clients’ Periodic/Trigger Review.
  • Unless advised otherwise by the client’s RM, who will contact the client and arrange documents on behalf of the Individual CDD Team, The Individual CDD analyst’s role is to:
  • Initiate Client contact (for RM managed accounts, RM can perform the client contact on behalf of the Individual CDD team for document collection)
  • Complete CDD related documentation and ensure completeness of CDD information for ETB and NTB clients before submission to the IQC team who will check the quality of the CDD information before approval
  • Ensure that the information and document retained as part of CDD can be retained in a manner that meets legal and regulatory requirement as well as CDD Procedures.
  • Responsible for implementation and continued compliance with relevant laws and regulations (including changing AML related regulations), policies, procedures and risk control requirements through application of consistent group practices
  • Directs and executes activity within Individual CDD team and optimize end to end overall Individual CDD related processes and practices
  • Ensures alignment, maintenance and updating of relevant systems as required to achieve required operational and regulatory outcomes
  • Trains and provides business process and operational expertise and guidance to in-country teams in relation to understanding end to end the related processes and their connectivity to Individual CDD policy and procedure standards that impact their day-to-day business activities
  • Works closely with project teams/stakeholders to drive projects/initiatives related to the Individual CDD space to ensure successful and timely delivery
  • Assures Individual CDD risk management through testing of the related CSTs ensures compilation, review and distribution of M.I, reports and escalates exceptions and tracks to closure
  • Partners and actively collaborates with all relevant stakeholders across the Individual CDD functional and advisory space to build robust and sustainable operational and execution excellence
  • Other ad-hoc tasks assigned by line managers
  • Risk management: Fully understand the importance of risk prevention, prevent anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of risk prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed risk prevention in daily Work.
  • Governance: Adhere to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct. Establish the appropriate control and assurance mechanism to comply with all internal and external standards and policies. Proactively learn and take actions to ensure conduct initiatives well implemented.
  • Regulatory & Business Conduct: Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Group SME Banking AML & CDD Risk Management Team
  • Conduct, Financial Crime and Compliance team
  • WRB Business Teams
  • Business Risk Management Team
  • Country Operational Risk team
  • WRB Ops & Onboarding Ops GBS China

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in [China WRB COO team];
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Customer Focus
  • Courage
  • Instils Trust
  • Nimble Learning

Other Skills

  • Analytical Thinking
  • Operational Risk
  • Understanding Customer Needs
  • Process Improvement
  • Anti-money Laundering Policies and Procedures

Motivations

  • Personal growth and career development. Provide on-job training and AI training to help staff develop.
  • Recognition from LM and stakeholders in time when doing well.
  • Aligned with Group valued behaviours.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years’ experience and knowledge in Banking industry with AML/CDD related Experience
  • At least with University graduate with Bachelor Degree
  • ACAMS Certification would be preferred (Qualifications requirement #2)
  • Must be certified (as prescribed for the role) by completing all relevant SCB e-assessments (once these are rolled out)
  • Good at both spoken and written English and Chinese

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
